name: Drawing revision
description: v3 (W5 card, 2026-09-12; decisions #123–#125): the drawings track of a settings change, authored in the definitions screen. Step 14a identifies the drawings the change touches — or records that none are affected, which the owner says is the case for most settings changes (rationale documents change, drawings often do not); only when drawings are affected does 14b record the revision. The people who revise drawings work outside the platform in the drawing system, so 14b records what they did: the link to the revised set, its revision label and the date the revision was made. Drawing references stay text for Phase 1; the pattern drawing revisions follow is to be discussed and documented later, and a check step is a document edit for a later stage. Called by SETTINGS_CHANGE at COMPLETION over the same work request. v2 (W5) carried the legacy track's fields; v1 (W4) was a placeholder.

items.title: [14a] Identify the drawings affected by the change
items.instruction: List every drawing the settings change touches — schematics, wiring, setting sheets, one-lines — by its drawing number as the drawing system knows it, and commit Done. If the change touches no drawing (the rationale document changes, the drawings do not), commit NoneAffected and this track ends here.

body.title: [14b] Record the drawing revision
body.instruction: The drawing office revises the drawings in the drawing system, outside this platform. When they have, record what they did: the link to the revised set, its revision label, the date the revision was made and any note. The platform keeps this reference; the drawing system keeps the file.
